fullPassage: You'd think that whenever more than one person makes a decision, they'd draw on collective wisdom. Surely, a group of minds can do better than an individual. Unfortunately, that's not always the case. The wisdom of a crowd partly relies on the fact that all judgments are independent. If people guess the weight of a cow and put it on a slip of paper, or estimate the likelihood of a revolution in Pakistan and enter it into a website, the average of their views is highly accurate. But, surprisingly, if those people talk about these questions in a group, the answers that they come to are increasingly incorrect. More specifically, researchers have found an effect of group polarization. Whatever bias people may have as individuals gets multiplied when they discuss things as a group. If individuals lean slightly toward taking a risk, the group leaps toward it.

det.analysis: are increasingly incorrect: 부사가 형용사 incorrect를 수식. 동사/명사 increase를 부사 increasingly로 변환. '점점 더' 부정확해진다는 의미.

overlay.excerptSentences: But, surprisingly, if those people talk about these questions in a group, the answers that they come to are __________ (increase) incorrect.

questions.passage: You'd think that whenever more than one person makes a decision, they'd __________ collective wisdom. Surely, a group of minds can do better than an individual. Unfortunately, that's not always the case. The wisdom of a crowd partly relies on the fact that all judgments are independent. If people guess the weight of a cow and put it on a slip of paper, or estimate the likelihood of a revolution in Pakistan and enter it into a website, the average of their views is highly accurate. But, surprisingly, if those people talk about these questions in a group, the answers that they come to are increasingly incorrect. More specifically, researchers have found an effect of group polarization. Whatever bias people may have as individuals gets multiplied when they discuss things as a group. If individuals lean slightly toward taking a risk, the group leaps toward it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: draw on(~에 의지하다): 집단적 지혜에 의지할 것이라고 생각한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① give up(포기하다): 집단적 지혜를 포기한다는 것은 맥락 부적절
✅ ② draw on(~에 의지하다): 결정 시 집단적 지혜에 '의지한다' ←정답
❌ ③ turn down(거절하다): 문맥 무관
❌ ④ carry out(수행하다): 지혜를 수행한다는 표현은 부자연스러움
det.tip: draw on = rely on = depend on

det.korean: group polarization(집단 극단화): 연구자들이 집단 극단화 효과를 발견했다
det.analysis:
❌ ① social identity(사회적 정체성): 문맥에서 편견 증폭과 관련 없음
❌ ② mutual respect(상호 존중): 글의 부정적 논조와 모순
✅ ③ group polarization(집단 극단화): 편견이 집단에서 증폭되는 현상 ←정답
❌ ④ individual freedom(개인의 자유): 집단 효과를 설명하는 맥락에 부적절
det.tip: group polarization = 집단 극단화 (편견이 집단에서 증폭되는 현상)
